Resolve the following issue reported for this repository.

Issue title: env lookup plugin error with utf8 chars in the variable value

##### SUMMARY

The env lookup plugin fails with an error when the environment variable value contains an UTF8 character.
The problem exists since Ansible 2.9 and only with Python 2.7 

##### ISSUE TYPE
- Bug Report

##### COMPONENT NAME

env lookup plugin

##### ANSIBLE VERSION

```paste below
ansible 2.9.1
  config file = /etc/ansible/ansible.cfg
  configured module search path = [u'/home/admin/.ansible/plugins/modules', u'/usr/share/ansible/plugins/modules']
  ansible python module location = /usr/lib/python2.7/dist-packages/ansible
  executable location = /usr/bin/ansible
  python version = 2.7.15+ (default, Oct  7 2019, 17:39:04) [GCC 7.4.0]
```

##### CONFIGURATION

```paste below

```

##### OS / ENVIRONMENT


```
Ubuntu 18.04.3 LTS
```

##### STEPS TO REPRODUCE



```shell
TESTENVVAR=éáúőúöüó ansible all -i localhost, -m debug -a msg="{{ lookup('env','TESTENVVAR') }}"
```



##### EXPECTED RESULTS


```
localhost | SUCCESS => {
    "msg": "éáúőúöüó"
}
```
##### ACTUAL RESULTS



```paste below
localhost | FAILED! => {
    "msg": "the field 'args' has an invalid value ({u'msg': u\"{{ lookup('env','TESTENVVAR') }}\"}), and could not be converted to an dict.The error was: 'ascii' codec can't decode byte 0xc3 in position 0: ordinal not in range(128)"
}
```

The supplied test command has already been run on the initial workspace. Its output follows.
Investigate both environment and source causes. Test execution stages are observations, not root-cause labels. Missing records mean unknown. Use the raw output when interpreting observations.
